key: flat commerce fixture fails before comparison when destination is absent

bf-6c16eaa4c0d654629db8b963.what: The full integration suite could not compare flat and grouped commerce layouts because flat fixture preparation rejected absent destination directories.
bf-6c16eaa4c0d654629db8b963.root_cause: flattenCommerce in tests/integration/fixtures/paired-commerce-project.ts scanned destinations before creating them, used Bun.Glob's default dotfile exclusion, and performed that validation after the source rewrite pass.
bf-6c16eaa4c0d654629db8b963.fixed_by: Preflight every service destination before rewriting: create absent directories, include dotfiles in residue detection, and reject authored collisions. Five filesystem regressions and both maintained native commerce acceptance layouts pass.
